subject: Andhra Pradesh stamp duty transfer duty registration fee sale deed
text: Andhra Pradesh sale deed: stamp duty 5%, transfer duty 1.5%, registration fee 1%, plus user charges of Rs.500, on the higher of the consideration or market value. On Rs.10,00,000 the state's calculator shows stamp duty Rs.50,000, transfer duty Rs.15,000, registration fee Rs.10,000, Rs.75,500 in all. Older department PDFs showing 4% and 0.5% are out of date.
